A Microsoft exec just warned that AI is trapped in a ‘doom loop’ that steals news content.

The internal memo says this cycle could make AI useless and hurt publishers’ bottom lines.

Will new regulations stop AI from feeding on journalism, or is the damage already done? 🤔
